summary: OBJECT on one MUST-FIX. Five of the six measured inputs reproduce exactly and the subject is intact at a1337c9d… mode 0444, but the sixth — the file-08 row — cites 1cdcf9d4… where the live file measures f2a0f623… at 21766 bytes, a value the repository's own freeze-payload-manifest independently corroborates against the draft's pin. For a decision whose form is a table of measurements and which rests an MF-6 non-edit guarantee on that very row, a pin that does not reproduce is disqualifying as written, notwithstanding that D-104 and D-105 carry the same pin and the likeliest cause is staleness copied forward rather than any edit made in this cycle. Two further reservations are recorded rather than scored: I did not open the Codex v6 verdict, so the 'independent dual' premise and the ADV-V6-01/ADV-CMCV6-1 same-defect collapse are unaudited on the Codex side; and the end-of-review custody re-measure was not run. Nothing in the draft attempts a silent SATISFIED, a lock claim, a D-056 Class A opening, a corpus retarget, or a D-096 (A) grant, and the /date advisory is carried honestly — the objection is to the evidence table, not to the disposition.
